name: banana bread
instructions: 1 + 1/3 cups all-purpose flour, 3 bananas, 3/4 cup sugar, 1/3 cup yogurt, 2 eggs, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tsp vanilla. 1/3 cup butter can swap for the yogurt. bake at 350.
notes:
=== UNRETIRED (SEPTEMBER 2026) ===

Briefly retired (banana size/ripeness variance, bananas usually get eaten, surplus goes to smoothies) — then unretired: I was too harsh. The main reason it's back: BANANA BREAD IS THE BEST DESSERT TOPPED WITH A CHOCOLATE GANACHE (except cheesecake) — and it can take a PEANUT BUTTER GANACHE as well, which makes it unique.

zaynab issa, third culture cooking. original recipe calls for 1 cup all-purpose flour; we use 1 + 1/3 cups.
